creator: automatedintelligenceai
title: News explainer: Microsoft 'Project Perception' (public preview in Defender) runs red/blue/green AI agent teams that attack, investigate and auto-fix (open GitHub PRs, push firewall rules) with human sign-off on high-impact actions, on a 137B in-house security model

tools.name: Microsoft Project Perception (Microsoft Defender)
tools.detail: public preview, pay-as-you-go; 'Perception overview' dashboard, 'Agentic coverage', 'Recommended sessions'

tools.name: Microsoft in-house security model (137B)
tools.detail: handles ~90% of work, routes hardest 10% to a bigger model

claims: Red agents do recon and pen testing; blue agents triage findings and write detection rules; green agents fix (open GitHub PR, push blocking firewall rule)
One workflow compresses ~146 hours of specialist time
Every high-impact action still needs a human to sign off
137B-parameter compact model handles ~90% of the work
on_screen_only: Product video stills: 'Continuous, proactive defense'; 'Perception overview' dashboard with 'Waiting for input', 'Agentic coverage 83%', 'Recommended sessions', 'Agent automation 41%', 'Time saved 224 hours'
'What do you want to do next?' prompt chips: 'Am I protected from Midnight Blizzard?', 'Protect against a threat', 'Plan for posture remediation', 'Secure identity'
'Red agents — Uncover attack paths before attackers do'; 'Green agents — Contain risk and validate defense'

Approval card: 'Authorize scanning the production web app · Recon agent' with steps 'Probe URL endpoints', 'Run injection probes (SQLi, XSS)', 'Test authentication and access control'; 'Threat - Midnight Blizzard' summary
Workflow panel: Run recon, Pen test, Provide new..., Suggest re...; Inputs (1) Outputs (3); closing card 'Your defense should be too'

relevance.why: Enterprise Defender feature, not something a solo founder buys; the red/blue/green agent split with human approval gates is a useful mental model for an AI security-review pipeline in Claude Code (attack agent -> triage agent -> fix agent -> human merge), which echoes the liked Strix / on-call engineer content

implement_score.why: Not the product; but the pattern (separate attacker, triager and fixer subagents with human sign-off before merge) could be modeled with Claude Code subagents plus the existing security-review skill in a day

gap.what: New: Microsoft Project Perception announcement and the red/blue/green autonomous security-agent architecture with human gates. Liked set covered vibe-code security holes and Strix, not Microsoft's agentic SOC

verify: Is Project Perception the real product name and is it in public preview in Defender? Pricing model?
'146 hours' and '137B parameter' figures as stated by Microsoft or inferred by the creator?
Does the green-agent GitHub PR integration require GitHub Advanced Security?
